answerable.description: True only when the VESTI evidence is sufficient to answer the historical file-location question.

project.description: The project path exactly as returned by VESTI evidence. Use null only when VESTI supplied no project for this file; never guess.

evidence_session_ids.description: One or more session_id values returned by VESTI that directly support this file path. Never invent ids; omit the file if no supporting session id is available.

historical_only.description: True when the path is asserted only as captured historical evidence, not as a currently verified file.
